title: Pico RP2040 + DIP 245 on J400 — PRELIMINARY

text: RASPBERRY PI PICO. PROPOSED GPIO MAP. NOT P28 FIRMWARE.
CANDIDATE SN74LVC245AN PDIP. STOCK UNCONFIRMED. VCC IS PICO 3V3.
DIR low: J400 B side toward Pico. WRB is buffered and stops. It has no free GPIO.
VCC, DIR, and OE pull-up are assumed VSW 5 V. GP9 NPN holds Hi-Z when off.
J400 LINE NUMBERS. GUIDE SAYS VERIFY. NOT PHOTO SILK ORDER.
VSW assumed nominal 5 V. VBAT is not connected. Silk order is still unknown.
PRELIMINARY. NOT A POWER OR FAB RELEASE.
74HC245 is not used. LVC at 3.3 V accepts 5.5 V in and cannot drive a 5 V bus.
HCT at 4.5-5.5 V outputs a 5 V high. Those outputs stay on the J400 data pins.
ASSUMED VSW = 5 V. Verify 4.5-5.5 V for the HCT and <= 5.5 V at VSYS, spikes included, before power.
1N5817 anode on VSW, cathode on VSYS. Do not short VSYS to VBUS. No 7805. VBAT open.
Audio, SA0-3, DOUT, DREQ, CT, ASTRB, F2, WEB, BIGSPACEB, MNMIB, RESETSYSB stay off the Pico.
P28 sheet in this folder is a reference module, not this Pico board. Issues stay open.
